title: Phoenix's Archives
description: A mod focused on cleanly organized lore with support for custom conditions, quests, and gregtech modern multiblocks/singleblocks.
body:
Have you ever wanted to have lore at the touch of your hand without it being locked behind a questbook?

With Phoenix's Archives you can define jsons for lore entries/categories or do it all through the in-game gui.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_00be0de8-59d8-48df-9f74-475eb25b4a52.png)![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_b78252f1-caf4-4315-8d3e-082b41d7c7a8.png)

You can choose to have Lore Entries locked behind a conditon such as: A FTBQuest, obtaining an item, entering a biome, and much more!

With GregTech Modern and FTB Quests being optional mods, you can choose to run this mod without them.

Below is an example of a locked quest and an unlocked one

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_c2e63ae2-4396-44ff-9fcb-87fecf064ac0.png)![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_fcdb47c9-58f7-4e59-a2cb-fad120d93422.png)

By default there are no entries included, thou if you would like some example ones you can check out the github where some are stored.

You can open the editor screen by clicking edit mode (can only be seen if you have permissions) and clicking new entry or category.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_7c2fc3b7-198f-48da-abe9-310fed036e2e.png)![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_626f4799-db8e-4ad0-ab13-e0d00673a796.png)

I started this project as a mod for Phoenix Forge Technologies and thought I could expand it to be of some use to many people.

I hope you enjoy the mod! Also feel free to suggest any other mod compats you feel would be good.
